video_summary.overall_sceneDescription: An animated scene in a forest where characters from Ben and Holly's Little Kingdom interact, featuring a character dressed as a pie trying to distract a gnome from eating blackberries.
video_summary.main_content_summary: A character explains their plan to dress as a pie whenever Mr. Gnome is about to eat a blackberry to distract him. Mr. Gnome finds a blackberry, eats it anyway, and the pie character dances around to catch his attention while other characters watch from a small red truck.

audio_events.detailed_description: A male voice says 'Ta-da! As you see, I am dressed as a pie.'
audio_events.observation: Ta-da! As you see, I am dressed as a pie.

audio_events.detailed_description: A child's voice asks 'Why are you dressed as a pie?'
audio_events.observation: Why are you dressed as a pie?

audio_events.detailed_description: A male voice explains that gnomes love pie more than anything, so he dresses as a pie whenever Mr. Gnome eats a blackberry.
audio_events.observation: Gnomes love pie more than anything in the world...

audio_events.detailed_description: A child's voice asks 'Won't that be dangerous?'
A male voice responds 'Yes, very. That's why it's plan B.'
audio_events.observation: Yes, very. That's why it's plan B.

audio_events.detailed_description: A gnome character says 'This time, I promise I'm not going to eat it.'
audio_events.observation: This time, I promise I'm not going to eat it.

audio_events.detailed_description: The gnome says 'Ooh, look at that!'
A quick munching or eating sound effect.
The gnome says 'Silly me, I did it again. Focus, Mr. Gnome. Right, this is it, no more. Oh, a blackberry!'
audio_events.observation: Silly me, I did it again...

audio_events.detailed_description: The pie-costume character shouts 'Hey there, Mr. Gnome, look over here, I'm a pie!'
audio_events.observation: Hey there, Mr. Gnome, look over here, I'm a pie!

audio_events.detailed_description: The gnome shouts 'Ooh, a pie!' as other characters handle a large blackberry.
